$comment: Crawler configuration. Every adapter declares the hosts it may contact; requests (and redirects) to any other host are refused. Adapters that read documented APIs say so in robots_note; adapters that read web pages always honour robots.txt.
user_agent: ANTO-LTG-Crawler/0.2 (+https://github.com/flessan/ANTO-LTG; catalog research bot; honours robots.txt)

winget.description: Package metadata and hash-pinned installer URLs from microsoft/winget-pkgs.
winget.robots_note: Uses the documented GitHub REST API (authenticated with GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, sent only to api.github.com); no HTML pages are fetched.

vendor-pages.description: Label-driven extraction of version, date and size from official vendor driver/download pages listed in seeds/vendor-pages.json.
vendor-pages.enabled_note: Disabled by default because every vendor page layout is different; enable it per target after checking the selectors in the targets file.

driver-listings.description: Third-party driver listing pages (aggregators). Output is lead-only: records are labelled third_party_aggregator, carry quality flags and never include a download link.
